bio: Eldrin farmers are said to have Invoked Hain entirely by accident, during a bumper harvest when several marvelled at the size of someone's prized pumpkin. Since then, Hain has been regularly Invoked to signal the beginning of the harvest festival, with its giant scythe being used to cut down entire fields in seconds.
